name: 下一轮完整 Actor 预计算
baseline: SPORK with full reasoning, D1/D2/D3; same Qwen3-32B and generation settings
input: SPORK predicted call and its real isolated tool result
Exact next-prompt tokens, environment fingerprints and frozen generation settings
output: A completed full next-Actor response and isolated next-tool state, conditionally reusable after the parent completes normally.
training: No new model training or learned labels; original SPORK confidence threshold retained.
acceptance: Parent tool name and arguments match
Full serialized next-prompt token IDs match
fallback: Cancel and drain mismatching child work, keep its cost, and execute the next canonical SPORK turn.
scope: This SPORK baseline removes prior thinking from later tool-turn messages; no unknown future reasoning is inserted into the child input.
Validated in local isolated deterministic tau2 environments with greedy generation and the tested serving setup.
Exact-input checks are not a universal guarantee for opaque model state, untracked external effects or arbitrary nondeterministic backends.
Fixed user messages and turn caps are not official interactive tau2 success.

attribution.SPORK: Partial-reasoning tool prediction, isolated early tool execution and D3
attribution.Speculative Actions / CTES: Multistep speculative branches and compatible-work reuse
attribution.ObsSpec / ProSpect: Overlapping later model work with an anticipated input and validating input compatibility; this implementation uses an actual early tool result and live shared-GPU execution.

rejected_variant: The extra unforced confirmation gate was slower on the initial two-task comparison; it is retained only as an experimental control.
